stem: During an incident, an operator at Lumen Pharma resized a database through the cloud console. The team wants Terraform's state updated to the new size, wants to inspect the detected change before it is recorded, and wants nothing changed on the real database. Which command fits?

choices.text: `terraform refresh`, run once to pull the new size into state

rationale: `terraform apply -refresh-only` shows the drift and, once confirmed, records the updated values in state without modifying remote objects. A normal apply compares configuration to the real resource and would try to revert the manual resize. `terraform refresh` is deprecated and is effectively an alias for apply with refresh-only and auto-approve, so it overwrites state with no chance to review. A refresh-only plan on its own only previews the change; nothing is recorded until it is applied.
